title: Tip Calculator
statement: Build a tip calculator. As the bill amount or tip percent changes, the tip and total should update live, with no submit button.

rubric: Typing a bill amount updates the tip and total live, without a submit button.
Changing the tip percent recalculates both figures.
A blank or non-numeric bill is treated as zero rather than showing NaN.
Amounts are formatted as currency, not raw floating point.
curveballs: Actually, split the total evenly across a number-of-people field too.
Round the total up to the nearest dollar instead of showing cents.
Default the tip percent to 20 instead of 15.
